newsitem.title: USA: PECO Peach Bottom 2 unit trips off line.
newsitem.headline: PECO Peach Bottom 2 unit trips off line.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,100 megawatt (MW) Peach Bottom 2 nuclear power unit, in Delta, Pa., automatically shut late Tuesday after the main turbine tripped off, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday.
Before the shutdown, the unit had been reduced to 64 percent power on Tuesday for "a control rod pattern adjustment," the NRC said.
This power reduction followed a week-long series of snags at the plant due to a problem with an oil line to the generator.
The company was not available for comment.
